    Primitive boundary data under contragredient duality #

    The primitive multiplicity at a label is unchanged after passing to the label-aligned contragredient skeleton. Projective and injective boundary bounds exchange, while the translation-difference bound is invariant under reversing the difference and replacing right translation by inverse right translation. Consequently the boundary package on the opposite side is constructed from the original coordinate estimate rather than supplied as an independent hypothesis.

    Contragredient duality reverses Hom spaces between aligned skeleton objects.
